_comment: Minimal OpenMinion config template for RepoSitter. Generate the real one with: OPENMINION_HOME=$PWD openminion config init --provider openrouter  then apply the values below. The generated file lands at .openminion/agents.json and contains an absolute storage path for your machine; it is gitignored on purpose. The api_key values are dummy placeholders: the loopback relay (repositter/relay.py) discards them and attaches the real credential itself, so no real key ever appears in this config. PRIMARY ROUTE (Groq): OpenMinion ships a native groq adapter (an OpenAI-compatible provider), so the Groq route lives in the providers.groq block below (base_url = the loopback relay) and agents.openminion.provider must be "groq". EARLIER ROUTE (Gemini): OpenMinion has no separate gemini runtime adapter; its gemini setup preset runs on the openai adapter, so the Gemini route lives in the providers.openai block below (base_url = the loopback relay, provider_identity pinned to the gemini translation) and agents.openminion.provider must be "openai" for it. FALLBACK ROUTE (OpenRouter): set agents.openminion.provider to "openrouter" and use the providers.openrouter block; the relay then forwards to OpenRouter with the custom.openrouter credential instead.
